name: QSENSATO
description: QSENSATO is an Italian deep-tech company developing atomic-photonic chips for quantum sensing and metrology. The company uses femtosecond laser-written vapor cells (LWVCs) integrated into transparent glass substrates to build miniaturised, robust quantum sensors targeting space, defence, automotive, remote sensing, and biomedical applications. A joint spinout of ICFO (Barcelona) and CNR-IFN (Milan), with operations based in Bari, Italy.
highlights: Joint spinout of ICFO (Barcelona) and CNR-IFN (Milan) — combining leading European quantum photonics research groups
Raised EUR 500K pre-seed in May 2025 from LIFTT and Quantum Italia
Technology platform targets space, defence, automotive, biomedical markets with miniaturised laser-written quantum vapor cell sensors

news.title: QSENSATO raises EUR 500K pre-seed for atomic-photonic quantum sensor chips from LIFTT and Quantum Italia
news.excerpt: Italian quantum sensing startup QSENSATO, a dual spinout of ICFO and CNR-IFN, raised EUR 500K in May 2025 from LIFTT and Quantum Italia. The company develops laser-written vapor cell chips for miniaturised quantum sensors targeting space, defence, and biomedical applications.
